positions.name: AsyncRememberContractMechanics
positions.frame: How does the asynchronous remember contract structure dispatch, execution tracking, and reaction delivery?
positions.why: Segments src-1, src-2, and src-3 cohere around the ratified protocol mechanics for asynchronous remember invocations, articulating the relationship between non-blocking dispatch receipts, cursor polling, fault resilience, and piggybacked reaction handling.
